subject: Cleargrove sandbox activation + staging role-gate plan
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Harrison <paul.harrison@cleargrove.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cleargrove sandbox activation + staging role-gate plan

Hi Paul —

Great to meet on the call yesterday. Per our discussion, below is a focused plan to get your Cleargrove engineering and security teams into a staging workspace that mirrors your prod namespaces for validation but keeps data scoped to a sandbox environment.

Top-line asks from your side:
- A list of 3 initial admin users for invite seeding (email + role).
- Confirmation on whether Cleargrove wants API keys per-project or a shared integration key for initial testing.
- Any IP allowlist ranges for the staging endpoints.

Our proposed timeline (can compress if you want):
1) Today-ish: you share admin list + IP ranges.
2) +24–48h: Redwood seeds project namespaces and creates two API key flavors (project-key, integration-key) in the staging tenant.
3) +72h: Invite wave 1 to your admins, role-gating applied; onboarding call for key rotation and usage policy.

I attached a tenant_config_template.xlsx and a draft staging-role-matrix-v1.md to make the handoff faster.

Next step: can you send the admin list by EOD today? If not, tomorrow morning works.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: tenant_config_template.xlsx (spreadsheet), staging-role-matrix-v1.md (markdown)

From: Paul Harrison <paul.harrison@cleargrove.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cleargrove IT <it@cleargrove.io>
Date: 2029-03-21T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cleargrove sandbox activation + staging role-gate plan

Thanks Stephanie —

Quick answers below:
- Admins: me (paul.harrison@cleargrove.io), sara.lee@cleargrove.io (Platform Lead), and jon.kim@cleargrove.io (Security Ops).
- We prefer project-level API keys to start (easier to scope).
- IP allowlist: 52.23.45.0/24 and 18.204.12.0/22 (staging dev VPN egress).

We reviewed the role matrix briefly and will add comments in the Drive doc tonight. We'd like the staging tenant to disallow any export of customer PII — is there a quick toggle for exports? If not, let's flag it on the kickoff call.

-Paul

Monica / Aditya — heads up, admin seed below and policy request to disable exports for the Cleargrove staging tenant.

Admins to seed:
- Paul Harrison (Owner) — paul.harrison@cleargrove.io
- Sara Lee (Platform Lead) — sara.lee@cleargrove.io
- Jon Kim (Security Ops) — jon.kim@cleargrove.io

Key approach: create two projects in the staging tenant — "cleargrove-integration" and "cleargrove-sandbox-dev". We will issue one project-key per project. Proposed immediate access: Owners for Paul and Sara, Security-only for Jon on the integration project.

Aditya — can you confirm you can get the sandbox tenant up and seeded by EOD tomorrow (21st) PST? If not, propose a date.

Thanks —
Stephanie

Stephanie / Monica —

I can provision the staging tenant and seed the two projects by tomorrow EOD PST. Implementation notes:
- Will create the tenant with export protections enabled (tenant-level policy).
- Generate project-keys and mark them as "time-limited" (90-day default) in the notes; we can extend on request.
- Will put the initial keys into the secret escrow for Cleargrove and post a DocuSign-style ACK link for their admin to confirm they've received keys (security requirement).

Open question: do we want to rotate integration keys after the first-week smoke tests automatically, or make that a manual step? My recommendation: automatic rotate after 7 days unless Paul requests otherwise. That avoids forgotten keys in early testing.

I'll attach a short runbook once provisioning completes.

—Aditya
